rows.law: Ages advance on megabeast deaths and recur with ordinals; the <=3 great-powers branch is unmined and owed
rows.claim: Worldgen.ageText() folds the DF calendar law: boss kills bucket into Age of Myth/Heroes/Legends, each full cycle prepends an ordinal (Second..Seventh); WORLDGEN_MINE.md marks the <=3-powers branch UNMINED, owed, so the fold is honest about its gap.
rows.quote: AGES: worlds start in the Age of Myth; age transitions are driven by
rows.steal: Ledger-driven era labels from a plain counter: any fleet metric (merges, receipts, kills) can drive era text with ordinal recurrence instead of a hand-maintained status field.
rows.falsifier: Call ageText() at 0, 10, 30 kills and at cycle 2: cycle 1 must render 'the Second Age of Myth' via the gsub on '^the '; a double prefix or an off-by-one bucket falsifies the fold.

rows.law: Dwarven compounds are POS-legal: ADJ+NOUN or NOUN+NOUN
rows.claim: ArtifactLore.dwarvenCompound splits the lexicon into adj and noun pools by pos tag and draws first from adj-or-noun, second from nouns only, so every compound is DF-legal by construction; the embedded slice is 130 entries (80 nouns + 50 adjectives).
rows.quote: compounds now POS-legal per DF law: ADJ+NOUN or NOUN+NOUN.
rows.steal: Constrain generators at the pool level, not the output level: filter by type before sampling so legality holds with no post-hoc rejection loop.
rows.falsifier: Extract DWARVEN, replay the pool draw 10000 times: any adjective landing in the second slot, or any word whose pos disagrees with the language_words.txt join, falsifies.

rows.law: Game data is generated code: GENERATED by tools/gen_df_luau_data.py from corpus/df_mine/, do not hand-edit
rows.claim: DfGoods.luau (value tables) and RcpData.luau (weighted RCP profiles) are build artifacts of one generator reading the corpus mine; the editable truth is corpus/df_mine/*.json and the .luau is regenerable output (grep -F count 1 in both files).
rows.quote: GENERATED by tools/gen_df_luau_data.py from corpus/df_mine/ -- do not hand-edit.
rows.steal: Promote JSON mines to typed module tables through a named generator with the regenerate command in the header; a hand-edit to a generated file is debt by definition, the fix is upstream in the JSON.
rows.falsifier: Edit any table in DfGoods.luau by hand, rerun tools/gen_df_luau_data.py: the edit must be overwritten; if the generator is missing or leaves the edit intact, the generated-code law is falsified.

rows.law: Two-stage law: events log first, scalars derive, thresholds gate.
rows.claim: Soul.luau stores emotions as timestamped rows naming their causal thought, stress and mood derive at read time through the exact DF cutoff ladder (50000..-100000 into 7 categories); LINKS-345 wired it into HeadMuseum per-head, but gate output shows HeadMuseum.luau(16,26) TypeError Unknown type 'Soul.Soul', so the wire has a live type-level error.
rows.quote: Two-stage law: events log first, scalars derive, thresholds gate.
rows.steal: Keep derived state out of storage: persist rows only, derive scalars at read, gate on thresholds; revocation flags rows synthetic instead of deleting, which keeps the ledger append-only and auditable.
rows.falsifier: Re-run analysis on HeadMuseum.luau: the Unknown type 'Soul.Soul' TypeError must reproduce; if stress or mood are ever persisted to DataStore instead of derived at read, the two-stage law is violated.
